# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

This repository contains the Bulwark **website and documentation** only. Security issues specific to the Bulwark webmail application should be reported to the [bulwarkmail/webmail](https://github.com/bulwarkmail/webmail) repository.

| Version | Supported |
|---------|-----------|
| Latest (`main`) | :white_check_mark: |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability in this website or its dependencies, please **do not** open a public GitHub issue.

Instead, please report it via [GitHub's private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/bulwarkmail/website/security/advisories/new).

Please include:

- A description of the vulnerability and its potential impact
- Steps to reproduce or proof-of-concept (if applicable)
- Any suggested mitigations

We will acknowledge your report within **72 hours** and aim to release a fix within **14 days** for confirmed issues.

## Scope

This policy covers:

- The website at [bulwark.email](https://bulwark.email) (if publicly deployed)
- This repository's source code and dependencies

## Out of Scope

- Vulnerabilities in third-party dependencies should be reported directly to those projects
- Issues with the Bulwark webmail app itself belong in [bulwarkmail/webmail](https://github.com/bulwarkmail/webmail)
